text:
Tanya: Heads-up — AcmeRetail just hit a renewal flag, 36 days out. Usage down ~48% over last 14d, onboarding still at 'post-setup' and their main contact said 'haven't pushed to prod yet'. Need a short re-engagement + downgrade-safe path.

Ben: Noted. Can we run a 10-day microplay: 1) enablement call, 2) exec check-in, 3) temp credit + migration help. Assigning myself for outreach.

Oliver: I can run the enablement call — available Wed/Thu this week. I'll prepare a focused 45m runbook: product blockers, simple run-to-prod checklist, and a follow-up plan.

Amy-CSM: Adding context: legal asked for SSO docs which slowed them, and they had an internal hiring freeze so engineering support is sparse. They responded to last email w/ "priorities shifted". Exec sponsor is Sarah P.

Tanya: Ok — we should avoid immediate discounting. Try tactical free migration assist first, and a structured downgrade path if they ask. Ben, can you offer 30 days free migration credits and the enablement slot?

Ben: Yep. I'll offer 30d migration credits + a 1:1 enablement session with Oliver. I'll include a downgrade-safe checklist in the email so they know options. Drafting outreach now.

analytics-bot: Snapshot for AcmeRetail — monthly calls: 3 -> 0; active seats: 18 -> 7; avg latency errors: 0.4% -> 0.6%. Top failing flows: batch-import, webhooks.

Oliver: For the enablement runbook I'll cover: 1) minimal prod checklist, 2) quick webhook triage (common pitfalls), 3) fallback flow for partial rollouts. Prep snippet:```
Webhook checklist:
- Verify secret & retries
- 200 vs 202 handling
- Backoff on 5xx
```

Amy-CSM: I'll schedule the exec check-in with Sarah and loop in their CTO. If they want downgrade options, let's present: a) temporary seat reduction, b) lower throughput tier plus caching optimizations, c) pause non-critical integrations.

Tanya: Love that. Ben — send the outreach template below and ping once sent. Keep tone consultative, not defensive.

Ben: Outreach draft (will send after a quick review):
"Hi Sarah — noticed usage dip and wanted to offer a short plan to get you back to value: 1) complimentary migration assistance for 30 days, 2) focused enablement session this week, 3) executive check-in to align priorities. No strings — we want to make sure Redwood is helpful while you reorganize. Would Wed 11am or Thu 2pm work?"

Amy-CSM: Fine to send. I'll take Wed 11am if they pick that.

Tanya: Action items summary: Ben = send outreach + offer credits (due EOD today), Oliver = prep runbook (due Tue), Amy-CSM = schedule exec check (try Wed 11am). I'll follow up with a short play doc after first call. :thumbsup:

Ben: Sent outreach at 4925007945 — cc Amy-CSM, Oliver.

analytics-bot: Message logged: outreach_sent by Ben at 4925007945.

Amy-CSM: Reply from Sarah at 4925008001: "Appreciate the help — Wed 11am works. We can also demo a lighter tier if needed."

Tanya: Great — locking Wed 11am. We'll run the microplay and prepare the downgrade-safe options in the deck. Follow-up notes after meeting please.

Oliver: Roger. I'll upload the runbook to the thread after prep.

Ben: Will post meeting notes + next steps after the call.

Tanya: Thanks team — steady cadence here should keep this out of churn. :rocket:
